name: Lifeboat / TEMPSC with davit
description: Totally Enclosed Motor Propelled Survival Craft (TEMPSC) launched by davit or free-fall, required on manned offshore units, together with lifebuoys (life rings) and their self-igniting lights, self-activating smoke signals and buoyant lifelines. Evidence spans USCG/US regulations, the IMO LSA Code, Canadian offshore rules, a manufacturer datasheet, two patents and historical records.
aliases: Lifeboat / TEMPSC with davit (on manned units) and lifebuoys

specifications.metric: Totally Enclosed Motor Propelled Surviva — Offered capacity range, manufacturer
specifications.basis: Gohi Marine GLB series product table, 'Capacity 16-150 Persons'; 'Max. Capacity of 150 persons lifeboat is also available'

specifications.metric: Totally Enclosed Motor Propelled Surviva — Design mass per person, manufacturer option
specifications.basis: Product title 'SOLAS Approved 95KG Per Person ... TEMPSC'; seat design can meet 100 kg per person

specifications.metric: Totally Enclosed Motor Propelled Surviva — Full-load speed
specifications.basis: Gohi Marine table 'Speed >=6' for all GLB50C/F to GLB117C/F models

specifications.metric: Totally Enclosed Motor Propelled Surviva — Minimum speed, Canadian offshore rule
specifications.basis: Canada Oil and Gas Installations Regulations s.22(2)(e): 'be capable of a speed of not less than 6 knots'

specifications.metric: Totally Enclosed Motor Propelled Surviva — Self-contained air supply
specifications.basis: Canada OGI Regs s.22(2)(f): 'a self-contained air supply sufficient for at least 10 minutes'

specifications.metric: Totally Enclosed Motor Propelled Surviva — Aggregate capacity, manned installation
specifications.basis: Canada OGI Regs s.22(1)(a): two or more totally enclosed survival craft with combined capacity at least 200% of total POB

specifications.metric: Totally Enclosed Motor Propelled Surviva — Launch time, all survival craft
specifications.basis: 46 CFR 133.150(a): capable of being launched with full complement within 10 minutes of abandon-ship signal

specifications.metric: Totally Enclosed Motor Propelled Surviva — Embarkation preparation time, 2 crew
specifications.basis: Canada OGI Regs s.22(2)(j): stowed so two crew members can complete preparations for embarkation and launching in less than 5 minutes

specifications.metric: Davit / launching appliance and winch wi — Structural attachment strength factor
specifications.basis: 46 CFR 133.150(f): structural attachment designed to at least 4.5 times the load imparted and the ultimate strength of the material

specifications.metric: Davit / launching appliance and winch wi — Board davit-launched craft
specifications.basis: 46 CFR 133.150(g)(6): each davit-launched liferaft boardable by full complement within 3 minutes of instruction to board

specifications.metric: Davit / launching appliance and winch wi — Release gear proof load
specifications.basis: 46 CFR 109.301(i)(5): release gear operationally tested under load of 1.1 times total mass of lifeboat with full complement, whenever overhauled or at least once every 5 years

specifications.metric: Davit / launching appliance and winch wi — Launching appliance examination interval
specifications.basis: 46 CFR 109.301(i)(2): thoroughly examined at intervals not exceeding 5 years, followed by dynamic test of winch brake

specifications.metric: Davit / launching appliance and winch wi — Fall renewal interval
specifications.basis: 46 CFR 109.301(j): each fall inspected annually and renewed when necessary or at intervals of not more than 5 years, whichever earlier

specifications.metric: Davit / launching appliance and winch wi — Winch lowering speed, training mode
specifications.basis: WO2013122479A1: first flow control valve 'set to control the lowering speed at approximately 30 m/min' when isolating valve closed

specifications.metric: Davit / launching appliance and winch wi — Winch lowering speed, standby/evacuation mode
specifications.basis: WO2013122479A1: second primary flow control valve permits 'increasing the lowering speed to 60 m/min'; isolating valve normally open ready for evacuation

specifications.metric: Davit / launching appliance and winch wi — Accumulator normal working pressure
specifications.basis: WO2013122479A1: 'normal working pressure of the accumulators is 200bar and the opening pressure of the multi disk brakes ... typically 18bar'

specifications.metric: Lifebuoy (life ring) with self-igniting  — Outer diameter
specifications.basis: LSA Code 2.1.1.1 as printed on SEAFDEC/TD page: 'outer diameter of no more than 800 mm'

specifications.metric: Lifebuoy (life ring) with self-igniting  — Inner diameter
specifications.basis: LSA Code 2.1.1.1: 'inner diameter of not less than 400 mm'

specifications.metric: Lifebuoy (life ring) with self-igniting  — Buoyancy
specifications.unit: kg iron in fresh water for 24 h
specifications.basis: LSA Code 2.1.1.3

specifications.metric: Lifebuoy (life ring) with self-igniting  — Mass
specifications.basis: LSA Code 2.1.1.4

specifications.metric: Lifebuoy (life ring) with self-igniting  — Mass with quick-release for light/smoke
specifications.basis: LSA Code 2.1.1.7: if intended to operate quick-release arrangement for self-activated smoke signals and self-igniting lights

specifications.metric: Lifebuoy (life ring) with self-igniting  — Drop test height
specifications.basis: LSA Code 2.1.1.6

specifications.metric: Lifebuoy (life ring) with self-igniting  — Grab line diameter
specifications.basis: LSA Code 2.1.1.8, secured at four equidistant points to form four equal loops

specifications.metric: Lifebuoy (life ring) with self-igniting  — Fire resistance
specifications.basis: LSA Code 2.1.1.5

specifications.metric: Lifebuoy (life ring) with self-igniting  — Number on manned offshore installation
specifications.basis: Canada OGI Regs s.22(1)(f)(ii): 8 if <=100 m; 10 if >100 and <150 m; 12 if >=150 and <200 m; 14 if >=200 m

specifications.metric: Lifebuoy (life ring) with self-igniting  — Lifebuoys with lights / smoke
specifications.unit: % of total (at least half), with not fewer than 2 with smoke signals
specifications.basis: Canada OGI Regs s.22(4)

specifications.metric: Lifebuoy (life ring) with self-igniting  — Buoyant lifeline length
specifications.unit: m (or 1.5 x stowage-to-waterline distance, whichever greater)
specifications.basis: Canada OGI Regs s.22(5) for two lifebuoys not equipped with lights and smoke signals

specifications.metric: Reliability — Release gear proof test load factor
specifications.basis: 46 CFR 109.301(i)(5): at least once every 5 years or whenever overhauled

specifications.metric: Reliability — Launching appliance thorough examination interval
specifications.basis: 46 CFR 109.301(i)(2), with dynamic test of winch brake on completion

gaps.what: Quantity/availability/reliability figures for lifeboats and davits on offshore platforms

gaps.next_action: Fetch the PDFs by an alternate method and record failure probabilities with basis

gaps.what: Lifeboat/TEMPSC purchase price in USD with dollar year

notes: From the Mistral-chat WHP component list (5. Safety and Emergency Equipment). Five Section-5 safety items were researched against primary sources actually read. Strongest evidence is regulatory: IMO LSA Code (via an HTML mirror), 33 CFR Part 145 and 149.417, 46 CFR 133.150, 109
